# Naksharix

> Naksharix is an online Vedic astrology platform offering free Kundli tools, traditional compatibility calculations, Panchang, horoscope, numerology and tarot reflection, along with optional personalized digital reports.

Naksharix is the platform's brand name, distinct from the traditional astrology term Nakshatra. Astrology and numerology content is offered for reflection, not guaranteed or scientifically established predictions. Consult the current official pages for pricing, availability, fulfillment and applicable policies.

- [Panchang](https://www.naksharix.com/panchang): Location- and date-specific traditional calendar.
- [Numerology](https://www.naksharix.com/numerology): Traditional number interpretations.
